question: Based on the 5th revision (r5) of the HTAN data, list the imaging assay types available at the HTAN WUSTL center that have Level2 data and any associated higher-level data (Level3, Level4) derived from them through 'entityId' relationships in the 'id_provenance_r5' table; exclude any records where the 'Component' is NULL or contains 'Auxiliary' or 'OtherAssay'; for each imaging assay type, provide the available data levels (Level2, Level3, Level4), and do not include Level1 data or Electron Microscopy assay types.
sql:
-- Final answer: imaging assay types at WUSTL with available data levels
SELECT 
  Imaging_Assay_Type,
  -- Build a string of available levels
  CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN Level2 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Level2' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level3 IS NOT NULL AND Level2 IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level3 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Level3' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level4 IS NOT NULL AND (Level2 IS NOT NULL OR Level3 IS NOT NULL) THEN ', ' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN Level4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Level4' ELSE '' END
  ) AS Available_Data_Levels
FROM (
  SELECT 
    il2.Imaging_Assay_Type,
    -- Check Level2
    MAX(CASE WHEN p2.Component = 'ImagingLevel2' THEN 'Level2' END) AS Level2,
    -- Check Level3
    MAX(CASE WHEN p3.Component = 'ImagingLevel3Segmentation' THEN 'Level3' END) AS Level3,
    -- Check Level4
    MAX(CASE WHEN p4.Component = 'ImagingLevel4' THEN 'Level4' END) AS Level4
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` il2
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` p2 
    ON il2.entityId = p2.entityId AND p2.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL' AND p2.Component = 'ImagingLevel2'
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` p3 
    ON il2.entityId = p3.entityId AND p3.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL' AND p3.Component = 'ImagingLevel3Segmentation'
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` p4 
    ON il2.entityId = p4.entityId AND p4.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL' AND p4.Component = 'ImagingLevel4'
  WHERE il2.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
  GROUP BY il2.Imaging_Assay_Type
)
WHERE Level2 IS NOT NULL  -- Only include assay types that have Level2 data
ORDER BY Imaging_Assay_Type
